auditor_kate: Hi all — auditor requested evidence pack for upcoming SOC2 fieldwork: RBAC change history (since 2024-09-01), KMS rotation proof, audit-log retention proof, one vuln triage linked to incident. Need reproducible steps or presigned artifacts.

sec_leo: I'll prepare a signed bundle. Quick plan: export k8s RoleBindings & ClusterRoleBindings, collect IAM change events, export CloudTrail KMS events for rotations, include SIEM query exports. Will produce checksums + PGP sig. ETA today.

infra_mina: SIEM queries ready: Splunk: `index=audits sourcetype=role_change earliest=09/01/2024 | table _time user change target` ; Kusto: `AuditLogs | where Action == "RoleModified" and TimeGenerated >= datetime(2024-09-01)` . Archive prefix: s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/pack-1799991111/ . Lifecycle=7y.

compliance_zoe: Please make control mapping CSV linking SOC2 CC6.1 and ISO27001 A.9 to exact filenames. Include who exported (name, email), host where export ran, and a short chain-of-custody note.

sec_leo: Uploaded staged objects (presigned 2h): https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-compliance/evidence/pack-1799991111/rbac.tar.gz?X-Amz-Expires=7200 , https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-compliance/evidence/pack-1799991111/kms-rotation.json?X-Amz-Expires=7200 , https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-compliance/evidence/pack-1799991111/inc-2024-2098.zip?X-Amz-Expires=7200 . Checksums: s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/pack-1799991111/checksums-1799991111.json ; signature: s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/pack-1799991111/manifest-1799991111.sig

oncall_bot: evidence-bundler: Pack created by sec_leo, files=7, size=18MB, expires=7 days :package:

auditor_kate: Good. Can you add a 3-step auditor-run checklist for validating KMS rotation entries? Need deterministic steps.

sec_leo: Audit-run KMS steps: 1) Download kms-rotation.json and checksums file. 2) Verify sha256 and PGP signature using pubkey at https://repo.redwood.com/compliance/pubkeys/leo.pub 3) Search file for rotation event: `grep -i "RotateKey" kms-rotation.json` and confirm fields KeyId, RotationDate, InitiatingPrincipal.

infra_mina: For RBAC diff: auditors can `tar xzf rbac.tar.gz && git --no-pager diff --no-index baseline_rbac/ rbac_exports/` — baseline stored at s3://redwood-compliance/baselines/rbac-baseline-20240901.tar.gz .

compliance_zoe: Once auditor confirms, I'll append chain-of-custody entry and upload final manifest.

auditor_kate: Thanks — I'll validate now and report back. :thumbsup:
